# HHLManyBody22.HhlCore

**有限HHL实际输出程序**

从真实有限QPE/rotation/inverse与测量程序构造输出，精确grid和off-grid完整workspace分别审计。

**边界**：PDF p5 Eqs7–10 and Fig2. A finite off-grid QPE output is generally a superposition of clock words; rotating them and uncomputing leaves garbage. The source exact-zero clock and pure inverse-state conclusions require exact grid or a derived finite precision bound, not an assumed final state error. B coverage consumes the actual exact-grid QPE/rotation/uncompute/postselection circuit and actual physical inverse; arbitrary off-grid source assertions and numerical/bit-level implementations are residuals, not assumed output guarantees. The final HOM consumer explicitly supplies an equivalence of the represented data basis with n qubits; general non-power-of-two padded Hamiltonian transport is not claimed merely from the separate finite register encoder.

**覆盖等级**：B
